entries.en: Antonella found the missing earring beneath a folded napkin.
entries.zh: 安东内拉在一张折好的餐巾下面找到了丢失的耳环。

entries.en: Antonelli left the ladder outside until the muddy steps had dried.
entries.zh: 安东内利把梯子留在外面，等沾泥的梯级晾干。

entries.en: The parcel Antonello collected was too wide for his bicycle basket.
entries.zh: 安东内洛取来的包裹太宽，放不进他的自行车篮。

entries.en: Antonie covered the bread with a cloth before opening the window.
entries.zh: 安东尼先用布盖住面包，然后才打开窗户。

entries.en: Antonietta picked a smaller suitcase for the journey.
entries.zh: 安东涅塔为这次旅行选了一个较小的行李箱。

entries.en: Antonina noticed a loose stitch along the edge of the blanket.
entries.zh: 安东尼娜注意到毯子的边缘有一处线脚松了。

entries.en: Antonino held the umbrella while we carried the boxes indoors.
entries.zh: 我们把箱子搬进室内时，安东尼诺举着伞。

entries.en: Antonioni asked for a plain envelope large enough for the photographs.
entries.zh: 安东尼奥尼要了一个足够装下那些照片的素色信封。

entries.en: Antonis moved the music stand away from the draughty doorway.
entries.zh: 安东尼斯把乐谱架从漏风的门口挪开了。

entries.en: The novelist uses antonomasia by calling the mayor the Fox.
entries.zh: 小说家用换称法，把市长称为“狐狸”。

entries.en: Antonova asked us to keep the narrow passage free of boxes.
entries.zh: 安东诺娃请我们不要在狭窄的过道上堆箱子。

entries.en: Antonovich put a bookmark beside the passage we planned to discuss.
entries.zh: 安东诺维奇在我们打算讨论的段落旁夹了一枚书签。

entries.en: Antoon brought a soft brush to clean the carved wooden frame.
entries.zh: 安东带来一把软刷子，用来清洁雕花木框。

entries.en: Antos saved the receipt in case the kettle needed replacing.
entries.zh: 安托斯留好了收据，以防需要更换水壶。

entries.en: Antoun found a sheltered bench where we could finish our sandwiches.
entries.zh: 安东找到了一张避风的长椅，我们可以在那里吃完三明治。

entries.en: The wandering knight rested in an antre beneath the cliff.
entries.zh: 那位流浪骑士在悬崖下的洞窟里歇息。

entries.en: Antti measured the doorway before ordering the replacement cabinet.
entries.zh: 安蒂订购替换用的柜子前，先测量了门口。

entries.en: Antun kept the wooden offcuts for a smaller repair job.
entries.zh: 安通把剩下的木料留着，用于一项较小的维修工作。

entries.en: Antz folded the chairs while the last guests collected their coats.
entries.zh: 最后几位客人取外套时，安茨在折叠椅子。

entries.en: Anuj offered his window seat to the child beside him.
entries.zh: 阿努杰主动把靠窗的座位让给身旁的孩子。

entries.meaningZh: 阿奴拉达普勒〔斯里兰卡城市名〕
entries.en: Our friends sent us a postcard from Anuradhapura.
entries.zh: 我们的朋友从阿奴拉达普勒寄来了一张明信片。

entries.en: The zoology seminar compared several drawings illustrating anury.
entries.zh: 动物学研讨会比较了几幅展示无尾性的图画。

entries.en: Anushka waited until the glue had dried before lifting the model.
entries.zh: 阿努什卡等胶水干了，才抬起模型。

entries.en: The lecturer added an anyon to the diagram during the discussion.
entries.zh: 讨论过程中，讲师在示意图上添画了一个任意子。

entries.en: Anza kept the tickets inside a pocket of the travel bag.
entries.zh: 安扎把票放在旅行袋的一个口袋里。

entries.en: Anze lowered the music so we could hear the announcement.
entries.zh: 安塞调低了音乐声，让我们能听清广播通知。

entries.en: The sketchbook contains a drawing made during our stay in Anzio.
entries.zh: 速写本里有一幅画，完成于我们在安齐奥停留期间。

entries.en: The appointment for aortography was postponed at the patient's request.
entries.zh: 应病人的要求，主动脉X光摄影的预约被推迟了。

entries.en: Aoshima left a spare umbrella beside the office entrance.
entries.zh: 青岛在办公室入口旁留了一把备用雨伞。

entries.en: Aout wrote the new address on the back of an envelope.
entries.zh: 阿乌特把新地址写在一个信封的背面。

entries.en: Her argument relied on apagoge rather than a direct construction.
entries.zh: 她的论证采用了反证法，而不是直接构造。

entries.en: Apara kept one corner of the table free for the sewing machine.
entries.zh: 阿帕拉把桌子的一角空出来，留给缝纫机。

entries.en: Aparecido asked whether we had enough chairs for the visitors.
entries.zh: 阿帕雷西多问我们的椅子够不够来客坐。

entries.en: He removed the aparejo before brushing the mule's back.
entries.zh: 他先卸下了皮制荷鞍，再刷骡子的背。

entries.en: We booked an aparthotel because we wanted to cook our own meals.
entries.zh: 我们预订了公寓旅馆，因为想自己做饭。

entries.en: A burst pipe left the entire apartment-house without water.
entries.zh: 一根水管爆裂，导致整栋公寓楼停水。

entries.en: The diagram placed apastron at the orbit's farthest point from the star.
entries.zh: 示意图把远星点标在轨道离主星最远的位置。

entries.en: Their discussion of apatheia continued long after the philosophy lecture.
entries.zh: 哲学讲座结束很久后，他们还在讨论无欲心境。

entries.en: Actors dressed as ape-men waited behind the painted scenery.
entries.zh: 装扮成猿人的演员们在绘制的布景后面等候。

entries.en: Apel checked the winding path against the map once more.
entries.zh: 阿佩尔再次对照地图查看了那条蜿蜒的小路。

entries.en: The illustrator drew an apelet reaching towards a low branch.
entries.zh: 插画师画了一只伸手够向低处树枝的小猿。

entries.en: The costume designer adjusted the mask worn by the apeman in the play.
entries.zh: 服装设计师调整了剧中猿人角色戴的面具。

entries.en: The old physician's letter described the traveller's persistent apepsy.
entries.zh: 那位旧时医生在信中描述了旅行者持续的消化不良。

entries.en: The analysis examined aperiodicity rather than assuming a repeating pattern.
entries.zh: 这项分析考察了非周期性，而没有假定存在重复的模式。

entries.en: Apert carried the folded screen upstairs while we moved the smaller chairs.
entries.zh: 我们搬较小的椅子时，阿佩尔把折叠屏风搬上了楼。

entries.en: The technician checked the apertometer before measuring the microscope objective.
entries.zh: 技术员先检查了数值孔径计，再测量显微镜物镜。

entries.en: She switched to aperture-priority before photographing the shaded garden.
entries.zh: 她在拍摄阴凉的花园之前切换到了光圈优先模式。

entries.en: We shared a warm apfelstrudel after the long walk.
entries.zh: 长途散步后，我们分着吃了一份温热的薄皮苹果卷。

entries.en: Apgar found a missing button beneath the armchair cushion.
entries.zh: 阿普加在扶手椅的坐垫下面找到了丢失的纽扣。

entries.en: The library ordered new journals for the department of aphasiology.
entries.zh: 图书馆为失语症学系订购了新的期刊。

entries.en: The students marked the aphelia of two orbits in different colours.
entries.zh: 学生们用不同颜色标出了两条轨道的远日点。

entries.en: The class compared drawings of apheliotropism before examining the seedlings.
entries.zh: 全班先比较了展示背日性的图画，再观察幼苗。

entries.meaningZh: 失语症〔尤指言语表达障碍〕
entries.en: The therapist asked how her aphemia affected conversations at home.
entries.zh: 治疗师询问她的失语症如何影响家里的谈话。

entries.en: The unopened aphicide container was returned because its outer packaging was damaged.
entries.zh: 那个装有杀蚜虫剂的容器尚未开封，就因外包装受损而被退回。

entries.en: We counted the aphides on one leaf before checking the next.
entries.zh: 我们先数了一片叶子上的蚜虫，再检查下一片。

entries.en: An aphidologist examined the photographs sent by the worried gardener.
entries.zh: 一位蚜虫专家查看了那位忧心的园丁寄来的照片。

entries.en: An aphis was visible beneath the curled edge of the leaf.
entries.zh: 在卷曲的叶缘下面，可以看到一只蚜虫。

entries.en: Aphra kept the stained tablecloth for use beneath her paints.
entries.zh: 阿芙拉留着那块有污渍的桌布，用来垫在颜料下面。

entries.en: The teacher circled the aphthong before reading the word aloud.
entries.zh: 老师先圈出了那个不发音的字母，再把单词朗读出来。

entries.en: The drawing showed the apiculus at a much larger scale.
entries.zh: 图画以放大很多的比例展示了那个细尖。

entries.en: An apiologist answered the children's questions after the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览结束后，一位蜜蜂学家回答了孩子们的问题。

entries.en: Her interest in apiology began while she helped at a village apiary.
entries.zh: 她在村里的养蜂场帮忙时，开始对蜜蜂学产生兴趣。

entries.en: The photographer kept the damaged aplanat rather than discarding it.
entries.zh: 摄影师保留了那片受损的消球差透镜，没有把它扔掉。

entries.en: The student sketched an aplanogamete during the botany practical.
entries.zh: 那个学生在植物学实验课上画了一个不动配子。

entries.en: The chart recorded several apnoeas during the observation period.
entries.zh: 图表记录了观察期间的几次呼吸暂停。

entries.en: The seminar examined apocalypticism without endorsing predictions about a particular date.
entries.zh: 研讨会考察了启示论，但没有支持有关某个具体日期的预言。

entries.en: The apocalypticist in the novel interrupts every celebration with warnings of disaster.
entries.zh: 小说中的那位灾难预言者总会用灾难警告打断每一次庆祝。

entries.meaningZh: 预言灾难降临的人〔复数〕
entries.en: The satire shows apocalypticists disagreeing about why the world must end.
entries.zh: 这部讽刺作品描绘了灾难预言者们对世界必将结束的原因意见不一。

entries.en: Her essay on apocalyptism compared the imagery in two religious texts.
entries.zh: 她关于启示论的论文比较了两部宗教文本中的意象。

entries.en: The fictional apocalyptist describes a ruined city in the final chapter.
entries.zh: 那位虚构的启示文学作者在最后一章描写了一座毁坏的城市。

entries.en: The historian compared how different apocalyptists addressed their readers.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了不同启示文学作者向读者讲话的方式。

entries.en: We discussed Apocalypto after watching it with our film group.
entries.zh: 我们和电影小组一起看完《绝代启示录》后进行了讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 罪人最终回归上帝的学说
entries.en: The lecture presented apocatastasis as a disputed theological doctrine.
entries.zh: 讲座把罪人最终回归上帝的学说作为一种有争议的神学教义来介绍。

entries.en: The student marked apocenter on a drawing of the satellite's orbit.
entries.zh: 那个学生在卫星轨道图上标出了远心点。

entries.en: We compared the two images before replacing the older apochromat.
entries.zh: 更换较旧的高度消色透镜之前，我们先比较了两幅图像。

entries.en: The optics lesson considered apochromatism alongside other aspects of lens design.
entries.zh: 光学课把复消色差与透镜设计的其他方面放在一起讨论。

entries.en: The three apochromats were packed separately for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 那三片高度消色透镜被分开包装，准备送去展览。

entries.en: A dotted line indicated apocynthion on the mission diagram.
entries.zh: 任务示意图用一条虚线标示了远月点。

entries.en: Apodaca placed the rolled drawings inside a protective tube.
entries.zh: 阿波达卡把卷好的图纸装进了保护筒。

entries.en: We compared the spectra before and after apodization.
entries.zh: 我们比较了采用切趾法前后的光谱。

entries.en: The damaged apodizer was removed before the optical bench was moved.
entries.zh: 搬动光学平台之前，受损的变迹器被拆下了。

entries.en: The student underlined the apodosis in each conditional sentence.
entries.zh: 那个学生在每个条件句的结论句下面画了线。

entries.meaningZh: 古希腊、罗马浴场的更衣室
entries.en: The reconstruction drawing showed benches along the walls of the apodyterium.
entries.zh: 复原图展示了浴场更衣室沿墙摆放的长凳。

entries.en: The botany students compared two drawings illustrating apogeotropism.
entries.zh: 植物学学生比较了两幅展示负地性的图画。

entries.en: The apograph preserved a line missing from the damaged original.
entries.zh: 那份誊本保留了受损原件中缺失的一行文字。

entries.en: Apollon carried the folding stool down to the riverside.
entries.zh: 阿波罗把折叠凳搬到了河边。

entries.en: Apolonia used a soft cloth to polish the scratched lid.
entries.zh: 阿波洛尼娅用软布擦拭了那块有划痕的盖子。

entries.en: The discussion contrasted aponia with the broader idea of happiness.
entries.zh: 讨论把无痛与更广泛的幸福概念作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 阿波斐斯〔埃及神话中的蛇名〕
entries.en: In the invented tale, Apophis appears beneath a darkened sky.
entries.zh: 在这个虚构故事中，阿波斐斯出现在变暗的天空下。

entries.en: The grammar class compared examples of apophony in several verb forms.
entries.zh: 语法课比较了几种动词形式中的元音交替现象。

entries.en: The apophorometer remained in its case throughout the laboratory renovation.
entries.zh: 实验室翻修期间，升华鉴定器一直放在箱子里。

entries.en: The architect drew the apophyge in greater detail on a separate sheet.
entries.zh: 建筑师在另一张纸上更详细地画出了柱身的凹曲部分。
